sents.zh: 中国人做出了很多有用的东西。
sents.en: Chinese people made many useful things.
The four most famous ones are these.

sents.zh: 有了纸，人们可以写字，也可以做书。
sents.en: With paper, people could write and make books.
The second is the way of printing books.

sents.zh: 宋朝的人把字做成一个一个的小块。
sents.en: Song people made the characters into small separate blocks.

sents.zh: 第三个是可以看方向的东西。
sents.en: The third is the thing that shows direction.

sents.zh: 在海上，人们用它找到路。
sents.en: At sea, people used it to find their way.

sents.zh: 这四个东西后来到了别的国家。
sents.en: These four things later reached other countries.
